#### `def rebuild(filename, tag, format, zonegroups, metadata)` (Línea 12)
- **Propósito:** Rebuild the internal timezone info in dateutil/zoneinfo/zoneinfo*tar*

filename is the timezone tarball from ``ftp.iana.org/tz``.
- **Firma:** `def rebuild(filename, tag, format, zonegroups, metadata)`
- **Retorno / Efectos:** Consulta código fuente.

#### `def _run_zic(zonedir, filepaths)` (Línea 41)
- **Propósito:** Calls the ``zic`` compiler in a compatible way to get a "fat" binary.

Recent versions of ``zic`` default to ``-b slim``, while older versions
don't even have the ``-b`` option (but default to "fat" binaries). The
current version of dateutil does not support Version 2+ TZif files, which
causes problems when used in conjunction with "slim" binaries, so this
function is used to ensure that we always get a "fat" binary.
- **Firma:** `def _run_zic(zonedir, filepaths)`
- **Retorno / Efectos:** Consulta código fuente.
